title: Karawa language
description: Endangered Sepik language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Karawa (Bulawa) is a language spoken in Sandaun Province, Papua New Guinea, by decreasing number of people. Speakers are shifting to Pouye, which is closely related. It is spoken in the single village of Pulwa (Bulawa) in East Wapei Rural LLG, Sandaun Province.
